Night Shift: Not Human — Android build
=====================================

NightShift-NotHuman.apk   release build, arm64-v8a, signed, ~25 MB
SHA256.txt                checksum for the APK above

Direct download (open in the handheld browser):
https://github.com/InVisionx/mylas_game/raw/main/dist/NightShift-NotHuman.apk

Install:
  1. Tap the downloaded file in Files -> Downloads.
  2. Allow "install unknown apps" for the browser or Files app.
  3. Launch "Night Shift: Not Human".

Updates:
  The game checks GitHub on launch. When a newer build is published the main
  menu shows an UPDATE AVAILABLE banner; press it to download, then open the
  file to install over this copy. Progress and settings are kept.

Requires Android 7.0+ (minSdk 24) and a 64-bit ARM device (Logitech G Cloud).
